summary: Show installer download progress and installation stages with bounded transient retries
details: Release-bound and generic installers announce each download and show curl transfer bytes, speed and timing on stderr, including while waiting for a response. Failures identify the asset, curl exit code and elapsed time.
Downloads use a 20-second connection timeout, a 60-second low-speed timeout below one byte per second, and at most three retries for curl-classified transient failures and refused connections.

The generic installer verifies the manifest before downloading the node kit, then reports checksum verification, safe archive extraction and installation as explicit stages. Release-bound hashes and immutable installation checks remain required.

New release instructions download the bootstrap script to a file and execute it only after curl succeeds. Existing published release assets remain unchanged, so changing only the outer command does not enable internal progress for older installers.
